name: Sakura Uchiha
source:
Sakura Uchiha is a kunoichi of Konohagakure. Sakura has fair skin, green eyes, and pink hair. As a genin, due to her focus on her studies, Sakura lacked any particular combat skill, other than the basic skills she learned in the Academy. This greatly limited her role in missions, to the point where she frequently noted how much she relied on her teammates [url=https://vndb.org/c105089]Sasuke[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c105088]Naruto[/url]. 

After marrying Sasuke, Sakura became very loyal to him and even refused to leave his side while she was pregnant with their daughter, [url=https://vndb.org/c105099]Sarada[/url].

[In game description]
